subject: Renewal: request for one-time credit, term reset & SLA addendum
messages:

Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@ordera.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — reliability concerns

Sean —

Thanks for the call this morning. Ordera values Redwood’s inference performance, but the last quarter’s disruptions and token-cost creep have changed our internal economics. Procurement and finance aligned: to sign a 12–18 month renewal at our expected ARR, we need a one-time operational credit and a short-term SLA addendum (covering incident response and a small uptime credit bucket).

Specifically:
- $75k one-time credit to offset migration and validation costs tied to the Q2 incidents
- SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9% platform availability for the core inference endpoint and a 24-hour credit window for P1s
- A 12‑month term reset with a 30% discount on next year's committed capacity while we stabilize usage patterns

We’re prepared to sign within 72 hours if you can confirm those items or propose a counter that addresses the same economic hit.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform, Ordera

- Customer requests $75k one-time operational credit to offset validation/migration related to Q2 incidents.
- SLA addendum: 99.9% for core inference endpoint, 24h P1 credit window.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — Ordera — request for credit / SLA addendum (need authority)

Sean —

We should prioritize closing this with a narrowly scoped concession. Operational notes: Ordera is strategic (images/vision workload) and they are pausing a second product rollout until infra reliability is proven. Losing them would cost >3x the requested credit over 12–18 months.

Proposal (recommendation to execs):
- Approve a one-time credit of $60k (instead of $75k) tied to a signed 12-month renewal executed within 5 business days.
- Offer a 20% discount on committed GPU spend for the first 12 months (not total ARR); after 12 months price reverts to list with option to renegotiate.
- Provide SLA addendum: 99.9% for core inference path, 24-hour P1 remediation credit, and a 2‑month technical advisory package (two on-site/virtual deep-dives) to accelerate stability.
- Explicitly limit this package to this renewal and include language in the contract preventing retroactive precedent.

Mina — I included a smaller credit intentionally. Can you confirm whether $60k + 20% committed discount passes finance thresholds? If yes, I’ll prepare an exec summary for sign-off (one-pager).

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Deals

Marissa / Sean —

I ran the numbers with finance: the recommended package is within the strategic save tolerance assuming the following controls are enforced:
- The 20% discount applies only to the committed GPU spend line item (not embeddings or add-on charges).
- Term: 12 months. If the customer reduces commitment mid-term, the credit is clawed back pro-rata.
- One-time credit capped at $60k and recognized as a contract concession against Q3 revenue targets.
- SLA addendum is operationally feasible; we will add a 2-week SLT escalation clause and measurement dashboards (customer-facing) to reduce repeat incidents.

If you want exec sign-off language, I recommend we present a single slide: net ARR impact, expected retention benefit, and precedent mitigation language. Approve moving to execs for final authorization.

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Finance, Commercial

Elena / Tom / Team —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed this internally. Redwood approves the following one-time, limited concession package to finalize the renewal:

1) One-time operational credit: $60,000 payable at contract execution and documented as a one-time concession.
2) Committed GPU discount: 20% off committed GPU spend for 12 months only (applies to the GPU line item on the order form).
3) Term: 12-month renewal.
4) SLA addendum: we will execute the attached SLA addendum (99.9% availability on core inference, 24-hour P1 remediation credit policy) and include a two-month technical advisory package (4 remote sessions) to accelerate stabilization.

- If Ordera reduces committed spend mid-term, we reserve the right to recoup the credit pro-rata.

Sean — please coordinate with Legal to finalize the order form and SLA addendum. Elena / Tom — we are prepared to route signature immediately once legal and procurement confirm the attachment.

Best,
